connector.name: Mobile Device MCP by saranshbamania
connector.registryDescription: AI control of Android/iOS devices. Screenshots, UI tree, AI vision, Flutter, video. 49 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mobile-device-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the saranshbamania account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY

env.name: MOBILE_MCP_LICENSE_KEY
env.description: Pro license key to unlock all 49 tools (format: MDMCP-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX). Get Pro at rzp.io/rzp/r4ijQsJY

env.name: MCP_ADB_PATH
env.description: Custom path to ADB binary. Auto-detected from PATH if not set.

env.name: MCP_DEFAULT_DEVICE
env.description: Device serial number to use when multiple devices are connected. Auto-detected if only one device is connected.
